caller_is_owner.meaning: the increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() call is made by an onlyOwner caller

mev_monitoring.meaning: an MEV bot is monitoring the mempool for increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() calls

deadline_check_always_true.meaning: Uniswap V3 increaseLiquidity enforces block.timestamp <= deadline and with deadline = block.timestamp the check is always satisfied

protocol_financial_loss.meaning: the protocol suffers significant financial losses from MEV manipulation of the held liquidity-increase transaction

assumptions: The MEV bot is able to delay inclusion of the onlyOwner transaction until unfavorable market conditions.
Uniswap V3 increaseLiquidity() is the external call whose deadline governs execution timing.
The held transaction executes with stale pricing parameters before any caller-provided expiry could stop it.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric deadline value or concrete expiry bound; the deadline relation is represented only by the report-stated always-true check Boolean.
No specific financial loss or arbitrage amount is stated, so the loss impact is a qualitative Boolean rather than a numeric quantity.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the financial_loss impact; the separate no_expiration impact is not covered by this plan.
MEV holding, stale execution, and arbitrage extraction are described as capabilities, not verified incidents.
The deadline check is encoded as a report-grounded Boolean because the report supplies no concrete deadline constant.
